faq.q: What have condos in Central Port Coquitlam sold for?

blocks.text: The search above lists active MLS® listings in Central Port Coquitlam where the board's age field reads 0 or less: homes finished this year, and homes listed ahead of completion. Houses, townhomes and condos are in; land and income properties are not. Over November 2025 to October 2026, the busiest home type in Central Port Coquitlam was condos: 152 sales at a median of $572,500, and 3 types had 5 or more sales.

items.t: Central Port Coquitlam: 12 houses sold at a median of $1,210,000, with the middle half between $1,052,250 and $1,355,000. The median house took 28 days to sell and closed at 97.7% of list.

24 townhomes sold in Central Port Coquitlam at a median of $999,950 (middle half $757,500 to $1,054,900). A typical townhome in Central Port Coquitlam spent 18 days on the market and closed at 100.0% of the asking price.
In Central Port Coquitlam, condos sold at a median of $572,500 across 152 sales, and the middle half closed between $473,750 and $635,000. The median condo sat 24 days and sold for 97.7% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Central Port Coquitlam compares with the rest of Port Coquitlam

items.t: Of 10 Port Coquitlam sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Central Port Coquitlam ranks second lowest at $1,210,000; the range is $1,112,000 (Birchland Manor) to $1,410,000 (Riverwood). Birchland Manor ($1,112,000) sits just below and Lower Mary Hill ($1,255,000) sits just above.
Townhomes in Central Port Coquitlam have the highest median of the 5 Port Coquitlam sub-areas, $999,950, ahead of Citadel PQ at $910,000; the lowest is Glenwood at $765,000.

Of 3 Port Coquitlam sub-areas with 5 or more condo sales, Central Port Coquitlam ranks second lowest at $572,500; the range is $512,000 (Glenwood) to $638,000 (Riverwood). Glenwood ($512,000) sits just below and Riverwood ($638,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, townhomes are the newest homes selling in Central Port Coquitlam (median 2024) and houses the oldest (median 1974), a gap of 50 years.
